This seed previously guessed the opposite, that a company this size would have to partner and keep a royalty. The filings do not support that: Viking names two other programmes as the ones to license and is paying for its own supply chain for this one. Two things this number does not carry. The CordenPharma prepayments are a real cash commitment across 2026 to 2028 that the forecast has no line for.
